note: Games played through Steam Family Sharing. No Steam Web API endpoint lists these — GetOwnedGames only reports games this account owns — so titles and appids are set by hand. The achievement counts are still fetched from Steam by scripts/steam.mjs, so a 100% run listed here is verified, not asserted. The appid is the number in a game's store URL: store.steampowered.com/app/<appid>/ . Optional: add "hours" to a game to show playtime, which Steam will not report for a licence this account does not own.
